title: RADIUS vs TACACS+: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: There are two ways for a switch to check your login. R A D I U S is like a hotel key card. T A C A C S plus is like a personal security guard.

lines.t: Two ways to ask the server

scenes.heading: Key card vs security guard
scenes.narration: Both do the job, but differently. A key card checks you in, then opens the doors you're allowed. A guard checks you in, then approves each door one at a time. The guard keeps the whole conversation private. And the guard uses reliable T C P.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. R A D I U S only encrypts the password. T A C A C S plus uses T C P. Only T A C A C S plus can authorise each command.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva RADIUS and TACACS+ lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. R A D I U S: U D P eighteen twelve, password encryption only. T A C A C S plus: T C P forty nine, full encryption. Use T A C A C S plus for device admin. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva RADIUS and TACACS+ lab.
